# Test fixtures

Real DocC JSON downloaded on 2026-11-09 from developer.apple.com (`/tutorials/data/...`) and docs.swift.org
(`/latest/data/...`, `/latest/index/index.json`), used only as offline inputs for the parser and indexer tests.

- Content © Apple Inc. and the Swift project. It is not covered by this repository's MIT license.
- The swift.org navigator is trimmed; Apple pages are unmodified (unused `references` would have been dropped,
  but none were unused). They were produced by a small script that copies the saved pages as-is.
- Rights holders: open an issue and they will be removed.
